notes:
No sign-in or account is required.

AIPedometer is a one-time paid download: every feature is included and there are no subscriptions. The only in-app purchase is an optional consumable tip (com.mneves.aipedometer.coffee) in More > Support AI Pedometer; it unlocks nothing.

AI features (dashboard insights, AI Coach, training plans, badge messages and smart reminders) run on-device with Apple Foundation Models and need a device that supports Apple Intelligence, with Apple Intelligence turned on. On other devices the app explains this and every non-AI feature keeps working. No cloud AI service is used.

Health: the app asks to read steps, wheelchair pushes and distance, walking distance, active energy, flights climbed, heart rate and workouts, and to save workouts with their steps, distance and energy. It also asks for Motion & Fitness for live step counting; steps still work from Motion & Fitness if Health access is declined. Health data stays on the device; the developer collects no data.

Workouts are started on iPhone; the Apple Watch app shows today's steps, distance and streak. GPX route import and Expedition Mode are in the Workouts tab. Privacy policy and support: https://www.conhecendotudo.com.br
